_source: Lights.vb. dayLength is the original's 1e10 s, so the day never moves on in play (BIBLE D6, settled by U.CHN-T82); 1440, its own clock's 24-minute day (UNI-T46), is kept only as a data option: spike U.CHN-T91 judged it plays worse (about half of lit play in a bare red Dusk or blue Night tint), so it is never the default unless the owner says so. tintStep is r/g/b units of 255 per frame.
